preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(M, int) and 1 <= N <= 100000 and 1 <= M <= 100000 for N, M in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and M are integers within the range [1, 10^5].

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(y, int) and 0 <= x <= N and 0 <= y <= N for x, y in edges) for edges in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every edge (x, y) consists of integers where 0 <= x, y <= N.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and (line == '-1' or (len(line.split()) == N and all(isinstance(int(v), int) and int(v) >= 1 for v in line.split()))) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or a sequence of N positive integers separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == '-1') == (not exists_valid_sequence(testcases[i])) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Output is '-1' if and only if no sequence A exists that generates the given graph structure.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] != '-1') and (is_lexicographically_smallest(output_lines[i], testcases[i])) for i in range(T) if output_lines[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, the output sequence is the lexicographically smallest among all valid sequences.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] != '-1') and (generates_graph(parse_sequence(output_lines[i]), testcases[i])) for i in range(T) if output_lines[i] != '-1')
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, the output sequence generates exactly the set of edges (ignoring labels) present in the input graph.
